propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all current-revision findings, including bugfix-size-attestation blocks whose remedy (ticket plan attestation) lives outside the code diff

bugfix-size-attestation finding should be accepted by recheck-review when the ticket carries a valid plan-review attestation that buckets as accepted, while refusing other blocking findings or invalid attestations
eligibility check must read only the bot's own vote message and ticket store, using the gate's own classifier and bucketing, never trusting the requesting comment

parse failure paths (missing header, unparseable count, missing criterion line, unresolvable ticket id, classifier exception) must all refuse fail-closed, and refusal messages must name the attestation verdict
